Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		users: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.SuspensionDays>0)
	precondition:
		users.size()>0
	postcondition:
		users->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays-1) and
		users->forAll(u: User|if u.SuspensionDays = 0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND 
		endif )
}
